note: Differential of the released v1.0.0 router against the current working-tree router. systemone summary and 'fastgate: systemone' trace lines are ignored (added in R3.1); every other field of Decision.to_dict() is compared.
compared_against: working tree on top of 6031a15 (R3.2C Phase 1 candidate)
reproduce: git archive v1.0.0 | tar -x -C <dir>; run the script below once with PYTHONPATH=<dir> from <dir> (old) and once from the repo (new); compare
script:
import itertools, json, sys
from agentos import config as C, router
cfg = C.load()
types = ["classification", "coding", "review", "summarization", "research", "knowledge_ingest", "background_coding_escalation", "gpu_workload", "exit_code_check", "nonexistent"]
healths = [{}, {"providers": {"claude_subscription": False}}, {"providers": {"codex_subscription": False}}, {"providers": {"claude_subscription": False, "codex_subscription": False}},
           {"workers": {"claude_code": False}}, {"workers": {"codex": False}}, {"workers": {"claude_code": False, "codex": False}}, {"nodes": {"msi": False, "mac": True}}, {"nodes": {"msi": True, "mac": True}}, {"providers": {"nvidia_nim": False}}]
events = [{}, {"risk": "high"}, {"risk": "high", "human_approval_ref": "h:1"}, {"markers": ["payment"]}, {"eligible_workers": ["codex"]}, {"eligible_workers": ["claude_code"]}, {"eligible_workers": []}, {"already_classified": True}, {"task_class": "coding"}, {"required_capabilities": ["code.references"], "eligible_workers": ["claude_code"]}]
out = []
for t, h, e in itertools.product(types, healths, events):
    d = router.route(cfg, {"type": t, **e}, h).to_dict(); d.pop("systemone", None)
    d["trace"] = [x for x in d["trace"] if not x.startswith("fastgate: systemone")]
    out.append([t, h, e, d])
json.dump(out, open(sys.argv[1], "w"), sort_keys=True); print(len(out), "cases")
